scenario: I am planning a trip to New York City from December 10th to December 15th. I will be flying with China Airline on December 10th, as I appreciate their consistent smooth landing experiences and the meal service they provide aligns perfectly with my flight schedule. I also plan to have a layover long enough to catch up with a friend over coffee, but not so long that it becomes tedious. Upon arrival, I will be staying at a Hyatt hotel from December 10th to December 15th. I've heard their loyalty program offers amazing perks, and I am looking forward to enjoying the city view from my room at night. My colleague will be joining me, so a double room is essential for our comfort and privacy. I specifically look for hotels rated between 7 and 9, as they offer a great mix of value and comfort. During my stay, I plan to explore some of New York City's fast food spots. I prefer places where more than half of the reviews are five-star, as it assures me of a quality experience. Additionally, I enjoy outdoor seating options so I can relax and have a smoke or vape after my meal without disturbing others.
